question: Does recorded environmental organization exceed that reproduced by sampled geographic blocks and specified shared or smoothly varying climatic associations?

feature_contract.climate: Existing CHELSA 2.1 1981-2010 native monthly physical arrays.
feature_contract.annual: Reuse seasonal_analogues.climate_components: mean monthly tas, log1p(sum monthly pr), max(tas)-min(tas), population SD(pr)/mean(pr).
feature_contract.harmonics: Sum monthly precipitation fractions times cos/sin(2*pi*m/12), with January m=0. These retain first-harmonic magnitude and direction; no phase-only normalization or monthly rotations.
feature_contract.scaling: Equal occupied-block mass, physical-area weights within each block. Climate scales use availability only; held-fold mixture scaling uses training-block availability only.
feature_contract.limits: Six summaries do not exhaust the monthly curves, event weather, hydroperiod or habitat. No feature/PCA/rotation tournament.

cohort.primary: Unchanged primary M AND radius_unknown5km_m <= 5000 AND unknown_radius_contributors == 0.
cohort.broader_sensitivity: One-cell-per-block organization summaries on the 703 in-M center locations, using the same six features and mixture settings, without a second null-fitting/simulation exercise. Positional supports are not repaired by using their centers.
cohort.interpretation: Known <=5-km uncertainty still permits center-extraction error and block-boundary crossings. No claim of exact pond placement.

generators.uniform: Physical native area within each primary occupied block.
generators.shared: Within-block area times exp(f(z)): six linear and all 21 quadratic climate terms, including cross-products.
generators.smooth: Same 27 shared terms plus each of six linear climate terms times standardized x and y of the 50-km block center (12 additional terms). Curvature shared; linear climate coefficients vary gradually in two dimensions.
generators.conditioning: Each occupied block has equal fitting mass; each observed cell within it has equal empirical mass. Each simulated representative dataset has one sampled native cell per same block. Between-block recording density is conditioned away, not estimated.
generators.normalizers: All native primary-M cells in the corresponding block. No sampled quadrature.
generators.basis_scale: Center every basis column within block using native physical area, then scale by ONE pooled training-availability within-block RMS per column. Never scale each block separately.
generators.ridge: Mean-block negative conditional log density plus squared coefficient norm / (2 * number of training blocks). Fixed; no tuning.
generators.rank_audit: Save unpenalized within-block Gram eigenvalues, numerical rank and conditioning; ridge convergence does not establish parameter identifiability.
generators.adequacy: Compare shared/smooth conditional log density relative to within-block area using all eligible primary cells in the five inherited development folds. Save each fold and equal-held-block aggregate. These reused folds are not independent validation.

organization_statistic.description: Held-block predictive log-density gain of two-component over one-component Gaussian approximation; positive gain alone is not ecological differentiation.
organization_statistic.selection: One uniformly selected observed cell per 50-km block, using three fixed seeds without reading its climate. First selection primary; other two are prespecified sensitivities.
organization_statistic.folds: Preserve original train_native/test_native membership of each selected representative. This preserves inherited occurrence eligibility and guards for observed records. Simulated native locations vary within those blocks while role/source/precision slots are fixed; simulated geographic guards are therefore conditional block approximations, not newly validated pointwise guards.
organization_statistic.aggregation: Sum held log-density differences over all five folds and divide by held representative count; a block is held at most once. Also save every fold.
organization_statistic.small_component_flag: Fitted weight times training count < 5; report, do not search another covariance or component count.
organization_statistic.failures: Fail on unconverged/nonfinite fits or insufficient fold size. Preserve partial results; no silent omission or alternate learner.
organization_statistic.interpretation: A two-component approximation screen, not estimation of group number. Continuous skewed or curved distributions can benefit from a mixture.

simulations.draw: For each fixed generator and draw, sample one native cell independently within every primary occupied block according to its area-weighted probability. Apply the complete identical held-fold mixture procedure for all three representative-role layouts.
simulations.comparisons: Save the primary observed statistic and each sensitivity against its corresponding generator envelope, including empirical ranks and 5/50/95 percentiles.
simulations.calibration: Fitted-model predictive diagnostic, not a calibrated p-value: fitted parameters are plugged in, remaining spatial dependence and observer effort are unresolved. Draws are simulations, not biological replicates.

claim_ceiling: Organization in recorded climates relative to these specified conditional generators and this six-variable mixture statistic. No discrete ecological population, adaptation, ancestry or species-count claim.
public_replay: Reconstructs saved aggregate arithmetic only; no native inputs, fits, simulations or model parameters are reconstructed.
variance_replay: Checks six saved within-block fractions and percentage conversion; does not reconstruct the underlying native climate variances.
